name: MATRIX
recent: Matrix Concepts 宣布派发每股 1.55 仙的第二次中期股息，并公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的业绩。公司通过全资子公司以 1.693 亿令吉收购柔佛古来约 174.77 公顷农业地，同时创办人 Dato' Seri Lee Tian Hock 在公开市场及闭市期间增持股份。
notable: 宣布每股 1.55 仙的单层第二次中期股息，除权日 2026 年 12 月 17 日，派发日 2027 年 1 月 7 日。
全资子公司 Matrix Concepts (Southern) Sdn Bhd 以 1.693 亿令吉收购柔佛古来 57 幅农业地，总面积约 174.77 公顷。
创办人兼集团执行副主席 Dato' Seri Lee Tian Hock 于 10 月至 11 月期间多次增持公司股份。
risks: 创办人兼集团执行副主席 Dato' Seri Lee Tian Hock 在闭市期间及公开市场进行股份交易，需留意后续持股变动。
公司于 2026 年 11 月 27 日公告向关联方提供财务援助。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 3.156 亿令吉，环比增长 2.2%，同比增长 11.0%；净利为 6,019 万令吉，环比增长 55.5%，同比减少 4.4%；净利率为 19.1%，高于上一季度的 12.5%。

recent_en: Matrix Concepts declared a second interim dividend of 1.55 sen per share and announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026. Its wholly-owned subsidiary is acquiring approximately 174.77 hectares of agricultural land in Kulai, Johor for RM169.3 million, while founder Dato' Seri Lee Tian Hock has been increasing his shareholding both in the open market and during the closed period.
notable_en: Declared a single-tier second interim dividend of 1.55 sen per share, with ex-date on 17 December 2026 and payment date on 7 January 2027.
Wholly-owned subsidiary Matrix Concepts (Southern) Sdn Bhd is acquiring 57 agricultural land parcels totaling approximately 174.77 hectares in Kulai, Johor for RM169.3 million.
Founder and Group Executive Deputy Chairman Dato' Seri Lee Tian Hock increased his shareholding in the company multiple times during October and November.
risks_en: Founder and Group Executive Deputy Chairman Dato' Seri Lee Tian Hock traded shares during the closed period and in the open market; further changes in shareholding should be monitored.
The company announced the provision of financial assistance on 27 November 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM315.6 million, up 2.2% QoQ and 11.0% YoY; net income was RM60.2 million, up 55.5% QoQ but down 4.4% YoY; net margin was 19.1%, higher than 12.5% in the previous quarter.
